summary.text: Taigan Plummer is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Brandon Phelps.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is 25, has lived in Johnson County for most of her life, and has started two small businesses.

paragraphs.text: Plummer said in her 2026 Ballotpedia survey that her family moved to Warrensburg when she was 3 and that she graduated from Warrensburg High School in 2019.
She said she and her husband are raising two children in Johnson County.

She listed volunteer work with the local animal shelter and Warrensburg Main Street's economic vitality committee, and board service with the Survival Adult Abuse Center and the Fuller Center for Housing of Johnson County.
She said she became permanently physically disabled at age 21 after contracting Guillain-Barre Syndrome.

Among her key messages, Plummer said communities should be built for the people in them rather than for corporations, and that legislation should help citizens from kindergarten through college and trade school, with assistance programs for those who still fall short on bills.
